selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Bulletproof Host Virtualine Loses Its Domain to FBI Seizure
items.summary: It allowed customers to host hack-for-hire services, supported ransomware and infostealer operators, and accepted crypto payments. The post Bulletproof Host Virtualine Loses Its Domain to FBI Seizure appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 防彈主機服務商 Virtualine 網域遭 FBI 扣押
items.summary_zh: 該服務允許客戶代管僱傭駭客服務、支援勒索軟體與資訊竊取程式（infostealer）營運商，並接受加密貨幣付款。Bulletproof Host Virtualine Loses Its Domain to FBI Seizure 文章最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: CISA says max severity GitLab flaw now exploited in the wild
items.summary: Attackers have started exploiting a maximum-severity GitLab vulnerability patched earlier this month, according to the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]
items.title_zh: CISA 表示最高嚴重性 GitLab 漏洞現已被野外利用
items.summary_zh: 根據美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）的說法，攻擊者已開始利用本月早些時候修補的最高嚴重性 GitLab 漏洞。[...]

items.title: Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores
items.summary: Drupal says a highly critical Commerce Core access bypass is exploited in the wild and urges store owners to audit their orders. The post Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Drupal Commerce Core 漏洞遭利用攻擊線上商店
items.summary_zh: Drupal 表示一項極具危險性的 Commerce Core 存取繞過漏洞已在野外被利用，並敦促商店擁有者稽核其訂單。Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores 文章最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on MPTCP servers
items.summary: Security researchers at Anthropic have developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute commands as root on servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners. [...]
items.title_zh: Linux 核心重大漏洞允許對 MPTCP 伺服器進行遠端 Root 攻擊
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的安全性研究人員已針對一項嚴重的 Linux 核心漏洞開發出利用程式，該漏洞允許未經身份驗證的攻擊者，在執行 Multipath TCP (MPTCP) 監聽器的伺服器上遠端以 root 權限執行命令。[...]

items.title: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress
items.summary: Over 22.6 million exposed instances are potentially affected by the critical PHP flaws that have been targeted for over a week. The post PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 攻擊取得 Palo Alto 防火牆 Root 權限，但對 WordPress 無效
items.summary_zh: 超過 2,260 萬個暴露的執行個體潛在受此嚴重 PHP 漏洞影響，該漏洞已被針對攻擊超過一週。PHP2Shell 攻擊取得 Palo Alto 防火牆 Root 權限但對 WordPress 無效的文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: $2 Million+ Drained From Polymarket Traders in New Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Malicious code linked to a website monitoring tool was designed to hijack logged-in Polymarket sessions and siphon user funds. The post $2 Million+ Drained From Polymarket Traders in New Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 新型供應鏈攻擊導致 Polymarket 交易者損失超過 200 萬美元
items.summary_zh: 與網站監控工具相關的惡意程式碼旨在劫持已登入的 Polymarket 工作階段並轉走使用者資金。新型供應鏈攻擊導致 Polymarket 交易者損失超過 200 萬美元的文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
items.summary: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys. [...]
items.title_zh: Northflank 資安侵害事件導致客戶的 AI API 金鑰遭濫用
items.summary_zh: 雲端應用程式代管平台 Northflank 在發生資安侵害事件並導致客戶的 AI API 金鑰遭未經授權使用後，正警告客戶輪替儲存於該平台上的所有憑證與金鑰。[...]

items.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
items.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles. [...]
items.title_zh: Chainalysis 揭露因「攻擊性代理技術」導致的資料外洩事件
items.summary_zh: 區塊鏈分析公司 Chainalysis 揭露了一起資料外洩事件，攻擊者使用「攻擊性代理技術」存取內部系統和工具，暴露了客戶姓名、電子郵件地址、使用者 ID 和組織角色。[...]

items.title: In Other News: Anthropic Breach Dispute, UEFI Flaw Hits Most Servers, Cloudflare AI Data Leak
items.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Iran eyed in military freezer hacks, Copenhagen University breach, AI-powered malware. The post In Other News: Anthropic Breach Dispute, UEFI Flaw Hits Most Servers, Cloudflare AI Data Leak appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 其他新聞摘要：Anthropic 資料洩漏爭議、UEFI 漏洞影響多數伺服器、Cloudflare AI 資料外洩
items.summary_zh: 值得關注但可能被忽視的新聞：伊朗遭疑涉入軍用冷凍庫駭客攻擊、哥本哈根大學遭入侵、AI 驅動的惡意軟體。本篇《In Other News: Anthropic Breach Dispute, UEFI Flaw Hits Most Servers, Cloudflare AI Data Leak》文章最早發表於 SecurityWeek。
